section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes a study that evaluated the correlation between body appreciation and body image flexibility, and their associations with body dissatisfaction, moderated by BMI. The study was conducted on a pre-college sample of Black older-adolescent females. The findings support and extend existing literature and suggest future research directions for multicultural inclusion in positive body image studies.
